CRITICAL SAFETY SYSTEM SPECIFICATION: CSS-HSE-902
DOCUMENT CLASSIFICATION: RESTRICTED
DEPARTMENT: HSE (HEALTH, SAFETY & ENVIRONMENT)
TITLE: CATALYTIC CRACKING REACTOR SAFETY INTERLOCKS AND EMERGENCY VENT PROTOCOL

1. RESTRICTED CLEARANCE MANDATE
This document contains proprietary sovereign plant architecture and restricted emergency vent shutdown algorithms. Distribution is limited strictly to authorized HSE personnel and certified plant superintendents.

2. PRIMARY TRIP MATRIX & INTERLOCK LOGIC
- Loop SIS-01: Auto-trip initiator for reactor vessel R-101 overpressurization (Trip Threshold: 42.5 bar).
- Loop SIS-02: Thermal runaway quench valve activation triggered if bed temperature exceeds 580 deg C.
- Emergency Vent Valve EV-902: Fast-acting pneumatically actuated quench valve. Full stroke open time: 1.2 seconds into emergency containment scrubber.

3. EMERGENCY OVERRIDE & MANUAL SCRAM INSTRUCTIONS
- A manual scram or emergency shutdown can only be initiated from console safety station HSE-CS-1.
- In the event of primary automated sensor communication loss, the physical mechanical lockout pin on emergency bypass valve BV-902-SEC must be pulled manually.
- Immediate site evacuation siren (Tone 3 - Intermittent Horn) must be sounded prior to manually opening any atmospheric quench vents.
